description.value: The Centennial Activity Centre is a City of Coquitlam recreation facility built around a large gymnasium operated jointly with School District 43. It serves local residents of all ages through a mix of drop-in sports and registered programs. The centre is accessible via several Coquitlam transit routes and sits in a residential neighbourhood near Poirier Street.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is a City of Coquitlam community centre with a large gymnasium operated in partnership with School District 43, matching the OSM record. The website provides a phone number (604-927-6098) and confirms the address, but contains no mention of bike parking, water bottle refills, washrooms, or any cyclist-specific amenities, so all required and optional criteria remain null. The OSM building tag 'school' is explained by the school-district partnership but does not reflect current community centre use.
concerns: OSM has no phone number listed; 604-927-6098 was found only on the website and has been added to this record.
OSM building tag is 'school', which is misleading — the facility operates as a community centre in partnership with School District 43, not as a school.
Category assigned as 'Attractions' but a municipal community centre gymnasium is not a typical cycling tourism attraction.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: None of the three required WWC criteria (bike parking, water bottle refill, washrooms) are confirmed by the website, and this is a neighbourhood gymnasium/community centre rather than a cycling-oriented attraction. A site visit or direct contact is needed to confirm cyclist amenities before inclusion.
enrichment_extras.notes: Bus routes 151, 152, 153, 156, and 157 serve this location according to the website, which may be useful context for cyclists using transit connections.

provenance.category_correction_reason: A municipal community centre offering gymnasium drop-in programs is not a tourism attraction in the traditional sense; 'Services' or a community facilities category would be a better fit.

blurb: City rec centre built around a large gymnasium.
